headline: NO OWNER ACTION REQUIRED FOR THE SHADOW ROWS. TWO NEW QUESTIONS FOR THE WALL-FINISH TRADES.

needed_for_wall_finish_rows.question: For the current selected Qortuba plan, up to what height are the dry rooms (bedrooms, M.B.ROOM / DRESS, HALL / LOBBY) plastered and painted - 3.00 m as in the old drawing's rule (QP-03 / QP-04), or 3.20 m like the new wet-room tile, or another height?
needed_for_wall_finish_rows.why_new: QP-03 / QP-04 were set on the OLD revision; for the new revision the owner raised the wet / service tile height to 3.20 m and stated no plaster / paint height. Source exhausted (no section, elevation or height text in the DXF)
needed_for_wall_finish_rows.current: BLOCKED (no area published); counterfactual at QP-03 3.00 m recorded, never published

needed_for_wall_finish_rows.blocks: the wet / service reveal surfaces only
needed_for_wall_finish_rows.question: Inside the bathrooms and the PAINTRY, are the door / sliding-door / window reveals (the sides and top of each opening) tiled with the wall tile, or plastered?
needed_for_wall_finish_rows.why_new: no rule states it: US-07 covers plaster / paint reveals, US-01 the wall faces
needed_for_wall_finish_rows.current: reveal surfaces recorded with areas, trade NOT_ESTABLISHED, not in WALL_TILE
